decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive tactics and tempo control to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes creatures with haste and evasive abilities to deal damage quickly, backed up by removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional resources and support. The mana base is designed for consistency and flexibility, with fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board advantage to secure a fast victory.

The focus of this deck is on controlling the game through a combination of countering spells, card draw, and removal. By using cards like Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and Force of Negation, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plays while also maintaining card advantage with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. Cards like Swords to Plowshares provide efficient removal, while threats like Murktide Regent and Quantum Riddler help close out the game. The deck also includes land disruption with Wasteland, ensuring the opponent struggles to develop their own game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a board of elves to generate mana and tutor for key combo pieces like Natural Order and Craterhoof Behemoth. The deck aims to ramp up quickly with cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Once Upon a Time, while protecting its creatures with Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Allosaurus Shepherd provide valuable protection against counter spells, while Gaea's Cradle and other mana sources help to power out game-ending combos. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient combo strategy.

The deck focuses on efficiently controlling the board while applying pressure with cheap, aggressive creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter and Dragon's Rage Channeler. It utilizes spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will to disrupt opponent's strategies and protect its own threats. The mana base is optimized for consistent early-game plays, with cards like Mishra's Bauble providing card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to establish board dominance and tempo advantage by quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponent's game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt your opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze, while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Nethergoyf and Bilbo, Thief in the Night. Utilizing cards like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers, the deck aims to control the board and tempo of the game, while also using counterspells like Force of Will to protect your own threats. The deck also seeks to gain card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble, allowing for consistent and powerful plays throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using disruptive spells and efficient creatures to control the tempo of the game. With a mix of card selection like Ponder and Brainstorm, along with disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Daze, the goal is to disrupt your opponent's game plan while applying pressure with cards like Nethergoyf and Bilbo. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student also provides card advantage and the ability to dig for key cards. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game while applying consistent pressure to close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly dumping powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bringing them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate. Faithless Looting and Unmask help to fill the graveyard while also disrupting the opponent's hand. The key strategy is to cheat in powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with their strong abilities. The deck also utilizes Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers to control the board and protect its combo pieces.

The deck revolves around cheating big threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play quickly using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. Card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Stock Up help find combo pieces quickly. The mana base includes fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb to accelerate the deck. Omniscience allows for casting spells for free, while Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional utility. The deck aims to make explosive plays and win quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana through the High Tide spell in order to cast powerful combo spells like Mind's Desire and Time Spiral. The deck also includes cards like Merchant Scroll and Brainstorm to search for key pieces and maintain card advantage. Additionally, disruption is provided by cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. Mystic Sanctuary can be used to recur important spells from the graveyard, while Jace, Wielder of Mysteries offers an alternate win condition. Dress Down and Echoing Truth provide additional utility and control options.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands as a control mechanism to disrupt the opponent's strategy while creating a powerful board presence. It includes cards like Exploration and Life from the Loam to accelerate land plays, while Wasteland and Ghost Quarter can disrupt the opponent's mana base. The key win condition revolves around assembling the Dark Depths-Thespian's Stage combo to create a powerful 20/20 creature token. Additionally, cards like Sphere of Resistance and Malevolent Rumble help to further control the game and protect the combo. Overall, the deck aims to control the game using lands and combo off for a quick win.

The main goal of this deck is to assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 indestructible Marit Lage token in order to win the game quickly. It utilizes cards like Elvish Reclaimer, Knight of the Reliquary, and Crop Rotation to search for the combo pieces and protect them with cards like Sylvan Safekeeper. The deck also includes disruption elements like Wasteland and Pithing Needle to control the opponent's board state while utilizing powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance the combo strategy.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and removal spells. The deck aims to establish board presence early on with cards like Voice of Victory and Amped Raptor, while using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment provide additional reach and flexibility in closing out the game. The deck also includes some land disruption with Wasteland and Karakas to gain a strategic advantage.

The core strategy of this UR Tempo deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan using efficient counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck aims to tempo out opponents with cheap threats like Cori-Steel Cutter and Dragon's Rage Channeler while maintaining card advantage with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for additional card selection and advantage. With a strong mana base and a focus on tempo play, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through powerful ramp options like Cloudpost and Tron lands, and to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to accelerate its mana production using Urza's lands and Grim Monolith, while also utilizing cards like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Karn, the Great Creator to pull ahead in the late game. The inclusion of Planar Nexus and Stock Up allows for additional card advantage and resiliency against opposing strategies. Ultimately, this deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to achieve victory.

Utilize powerful ramp cards like Grim Monolith and Urza's lands to quickly cast game-changing spells such as Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms. Control the game with counters like Force of Will and Force of Negation while also disrupting your opponent's plans with cards like Kozilek's Command and Sink into Stupor. Stock Up on resources with Planar Nexus and Petrified Hamlet while searching for your key lands with Expedition Map. Once you assemble your resources, overwhelm your opponent with massive threats like The One Ring and Thundertrap Trainer.

The key concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures using cards like Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays and big threats like It That Heralds the End and Sire of Seven Deaths. With a mix of mana acceleration, disruptive elements, and big threats, this deck seeks to close out games quickly with overwhelming Eldrazi power.
